title: Jyn Erso
franchise: Rogue One: A Star Wars story
description: Jyn Erso began a defiant life of rebellion at an early age when she was rescued by Saw Gerrera. Beaten down and alone in the Imperial prison on Wobani, she found herself pulled back into the Rebellion and reunited with her father, Galen, for one last moment. Determined to carry on his work, she takes on a most desperate mission for the Alliance.
